A substitute ordinance approving the execution of the 66th amending agreement with SomerCor 504, Inc. to increase the amount of grant funds available in various redevelopment project areas, amend the Small Business Improvement Fund (SBIF) program rules, and authorize SomerCor 504, Inc. to continue providing administrative services for the program.

An ordinance authorizing the execution of a Redevelopment Agreement with BTH Development, NFP to provide Housing and Economic Development Bond (HED) funds for redevelopment of Altgeld Gardens Youth Center project at 13122 S. Ellis Avenue.

An ordinance authorizing the execution of a Redevelopment Agreement with North Lawndale Catalyst Initiative, NFP to provide Housing and Economic Development (HED) funds and tax increment financing (TIF) assistance for the Filmore Linen Services project at 920-922 S. Campbell Avenue.

An ordinance authorizing the execution of a Redevelopment Agreement with Hudson Michigan Avenue Owner LLC to provide Housing and Economic Development (HED) funds for the Hudson House project at 2222 S. Michigan Avenue.
